head: Gemini for Mac computer use: it now works your apps in the background
dek: The Gemini app for Mac can now click, type and fill in forms across your Mac's apps, files and websites to finish a task you describe. It's rolling out from 19 November in the US, in English, for Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers.
details: Gemini works in a separate background window, so your own screen and cursor stay free, and the chat shows a live preview of each step. You pick which apps it may use, can pause it at any time and approve key actions before they happen. It needs a personal Google account, age 18 or older, and a Mac with Apple Silicon on macOS Sequoia 15.0 or later. Google's examples include filling in shipping quotes from PDFs and building a Google Slides deck from dashboards.
where: US, English, Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra, Gemini app for Mac (Apple Silicon, macOS 15 or later)
means: If you pay for Google AI and use a Mac, Gemini can take over repetitive clicking work, but it acts inside the apps you allow, so it can also make mistakes there.
todo: Get the Gemini app for Mac from gemini.google/mac, allow only the apps a task needs, and read each action before you approve it.
thumb_words: GEMINI CAN NOW USE YOUR MAC
